source_contents.e1:
the game was between the National Football Conference (NFC) champion Philadelphia Eagles and the American Football Conference (AFC) and defending Super Bowl LI champion New England Patriots.
The underdog Eagles defeated the Patriots with a score of 41–33 to win their first Super Bowl
